svg.foreignObject:
<div xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" style="width:100%; height:100%; margin:0;"
      
      
        
        async function loadContent() {
          try {
            const response = await fetch('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zaka13alt/sitesinglefile/refs/heads/main/idk.html');
            if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Network response failed');
            const rawHtml = await response.text();

            const iframe = document.getElementById('viewer');
            const iframeDoc = iframe.contentDocument || iframe.contentWindow.document;

            iframeDoc.open();
            iframeDoc.write(rawHtml);
            iframeDoc.close();
          } catch (err) {
            console.error('Error fetching or writing HTML:', err);
          }
        }

        loadContent();
